description: This file contains the implementation of the ProjectService interface, providing methods for managing projects such as retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion. It uses Spring annotations for dependency injection and service registration.

classes.name: ProjectServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProjectService that interacts with ProjectRepository to perform CRUD operations on Project entities.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Retrieves a Project by its ID.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Creates a new Project by saving it through the repository.

methods.name: updateProject
methods.description: Updates an existing Project after verifying its existence.

methods.name: deleteProject
methods.description: Deletes a Project after verifying its existence.
